## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run lemma check <id>` passes
- [ ] `uv run lemma test <id>` passes
- [ ] Every reference case in `tests.yaml` names its source
- [ ] The README says when not to use the module

The AI reviewer will post its evidence and verdict below. If the author is the same model as the reviewer, a maintainer re-runs the review with a different model.
